title: Corridor step 6 — BCCR commits its own side of the pool
description: Cooperative commit-reveal: each Central Bank commits only its own side, a Cacti watcher observes the match, and the relay executes both commits together. This is the path the platform's own end-to-end test uses.
notes: Gateway: BCCR (Banco Central de Costa Rica) Central Bank gateway, spoke-crc. Requires the central_bank realm role — note that /api/v2 uses lowercase unprefixed roles, while /api/v1 uses the ROLE_-prefixed ones; both namespaces coexist in the same token's roles array. Send only pool_pair and amount. provider_id, side and w_token_address are labelled deprecated backward-compatibility fields in the delivered handler: the provider comes from the session and the side is resolved on-chain from the pair, because which side a Central Bank owns is not the caller's to choose. The alternative sovereign path (deposit-side / finalize / reclaim-side) is not interchangeable with this one. An earlier dual-sided liquidity/add endpoint that let one Central Bank supply both sides was removed as a sovereignty breach and does not exist.
